items.source:
Only necessary to check that we're not parsing our own bean definition,
to avoid failing on unresolvable placeholders in properties file locations.
The latter case can happen with placeholders for system properties in
resource locations.
items.translation: 只需检查我们是否正在解析自身的 Bean 定义，以避免在属性文件位置中遇到无法解析的占位符而失败。后一种情况可能出现在资源位置的系统属性占位符中。

items.source: If a configurer cannot resolve a placeholder, a BeanDefinitionStoreException will be thrown. If you want to check against multiple properties files, specify multiple resources via the locations property. You can also define multiple configurers, each with its own placeholder syntax. Use ignoreUnresolvablePlaceholders to intentionally suppress throwing an exception if a placeholder cannot be resolved.
items.translation: 如果配置器无法解析占位符，将抛出 `BeanDefinitionStoreException`。如果您想检查多个属性文件，请通过 locations 属性指定多个资源。您还可以定义多个配置器，每个配置器拥有其自身的占位符语法。使用 ignoreUnresolvablePlaceholders 有意抑制在无法解析占位符时抛出异常。

items.source: Default property values can be defined globally for each configurer instance via the properties property, or on a property-by-property basis using the value separator which is ":" by default and customizable via setValueSeparator(String).
items.translation: 默认属性值可以通过 `properties` 属性为每个配置器实例全局定义，或者使用默认值为 `":" 且可通过 setValueSeparator(String) 自定义的值分隔符逐属性进行定义。

items.source: The default is "${".
items.translation: 默认值为 "${"。

items.source: The default is "}".
items.translation: 默认值为"}"。

items.source: The default is ":".
items.translation: 默认值为":"。

items.source: By default, no such null value is defined. This means that there is no way to express null as a property value unless you explicitly map a corresponding value here.
items.translation: 默认情况下，未定义此类空值。这意味着除非在此处显式映射对应的值，否则无法将 `null` 表示为属性值。

Note that this will only apply to full property values,
not to parts of concatenated values.
items.translation: 请注意，此规则仅适用于完整的属性值，不适用于连接值的一部分。

items.source:
Default is "false": An exception will be thrown if a placeholder fails
to resolve. Switch this flag to "true" in order to preserve the placeholder
String as-is in such a case, leaving it up to other placeholder configurers
to resolve it.
items.translation: 默认为 "false"：如果占位符解析失败，将抛出异常。将此标志切换为 "true" 以保留占位符字符串原样不变，将其交由其他占位符配置器进行解析。

items.source: Set the escape character to use to ignore the placeholder prefix and the value separator, or null if no escaping should take place.
items.translation: 设置用于忽略占位符前缀和值分隔符的转义字符，或者如果不需要转义则设置为`null`。

items.source: Default escape character: '\'.
items.translation: 默认转义字符：'\'。

items.source: Default placeholder prefix: "${".
items.translation: 默认占位符前缀："${"。

items.source: Default placeholder suffix: "}".
items.translation: 默认占位符后缀："}"。

items.source: Default value separator: ":".
items.translation: 默认值分隔符：":"。

items.source:
Only necessary to check that we're not parsing our own bean definition,
to avoid failing on unresolvable placeholders in properties file locations.
items.translation: 只需检查我们是否正在解析自身的 Bean 定义，以避免在属性文件位置中遇到无法解析的占位符时失败。

items.source: Default is false.
items.translation: 默认值为false。

items.source: Set a value that should be treated as null when resolved as a placeholder value: for example, "" (empty String) or "null".
items.translation: 设置一个在解析为占位符值时应被视为 `null` 的值：例如，""（空字符串）或 "null"。

items.source: Specify the separating character between the placeholder variable and the associated default value, or null if no such special character should be processed as a value separator.
items.translation: 指定占位符变量与关联默认值之间的分隔字符，或者如果不应将任何特殊字符处理为值分隔符，则指定 `null`。

items.source: Set whether to ignore unresolvable placeholders.
items.translation: 设置是否忽略无法解析的占位符。

items.source: Set the prefix that a placeholder string starts with.
items.translation: 设置占位符字符串的前缀。

items.source: Set the suffix that a placeholder string ends with.
items.translation: 设置占位符字符串的结尾后缀。

items.source:
Specify whether to trim resolved values before applying them,
removing superfluous whitespace from the beginning and end.
items.translation: 指定是否在应用之前修剪解析后的值，从而移除开头和结尾的多余空白。

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean in the factory. Note that this name is the actual bean name used in the factory, which may differ from the originally specified name: in particular for inner bean names, the actual bean name might have been made unique through appending "#..." suffixes. Use the BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String) method to extract the original bean name (without suffix), if desired.
items.translation: beanName - 工厂中 Bean 的名称。请注意，此名称是工厂中实际使用的 Bean 名称，可能与最初指定的名称不同：特别是对于内部 Bean 名称，实际 Bean 名称可能已通过追加"#..."后缀使其唯一化。如需提取原始 Bean 名称（不带后缀），请使用BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String)方法。

items.source: beanFactory - owning BeanFactory (never null). The bean can immediately call methods on the factory.
items.translation: beanFactory - 拥有该 Bean 的 BeanFactory（永远不会为 null）。 该 Bean 可以立即调用工厂上的方法。
